reasons: Section 9.4 as cited grants Customer a convenience-termination right on thirty days' written notice for the Agreement or any Order Form, in whole or in part, with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and no early-termination fee — this matches the T4C preferred position on every material term.

The clause also expressly denies Vendor any convenience-termination right during a committed term, satisfying the second limb of the preferred position; the deterministic check confirms a Customer convenience right is present.
Consistent with the claimed compliant status, the redline is identical to the original paragraph and no comment was raised, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The rationale appropriately notes the tension with § 2.1's take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights' language and defers it to the MINCOMMIT rule rather than double-flagging the same commercial term, which is in line with the playbook's classification instructions.
